quotes: It worked. It charged the battery. You have to know that a USB charger like this will take 24-48 hours to charge the battery....
It works...ish - it's single battery charge and it's iffy - I need to find a good solid charger than doesn't feel sketchy but, it works...
Charges as it should, light indicator was a little difficult to understand at first, not a fast charger.
When I went to use the battery, it only lasted about 30 minutes. It never got fully charged. And that was at the higher amperage....
features.summary: Customers have mixed experiences with the battery charger's performance, with some reporting quick charging while others find it slow.

features.name: charging indicator
quotes: Great value, nice to have a charging status indicator, and selectable charging current.
Bad design on battery charge level display and slow charging.
They both died quickly. This one has a neat little meter that shows you the charge. Great charger for very little money.
Charging Indicator Needs Improvement
